title: list_filter choices are limited to top-level nodes in admin list view (v7)
author: solarissmoke
body_preview: Because we currently filter the root queryset given to the `ChangeList`, any filters specified in `list_filter` are also restricted to this queryset. This means the choices displayed for filtering are limited.   Ideally we should use the unfiltered queryset for those filters. title: Multi-field ordering silently sorts by the wrong field when using QueryArrayWidget (value order not preserved)
author: juneja-varun
